vb_textbox.text: Ensure that you have your fingers on the relevant keys and that you press them in a timely fashion so that you don't fail to score on any of the rounds. I tried to detect a pattern which would increase my chance of achieving a high score, but I didn't notice anything obvious.  I did feel that going with the small hat when there was a small/large pair did more often than not lead to a reasonable score or at least avoided a zero score. Without knowing what the score would have been for the large hat, that is rather speculative though.
